statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The patient's symptoms are concerning for potential arrhythmia
The patient has known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The service was ordered to correlate symptomatic events with cardiac rhythm disturbances over an extended monitoring period
The diagnosis codes are I34.0 and R42
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial was based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization before services were rendered
